summary: WP-P3 adapter-lifecycle correction. Preserve six function ports and add one repository-local non-secret readiness attestation store. Explicit verifyReadiness remains the only authorization creator; later CLI/MCP processes require its exact canonical/content/index/channel evidence and may re-read WP-P2 only to reject stale evidence. Init, backfill, canonical mutation, graph digest drift, and readiness drift invalidate. System/unified semantic queries route through the operator; snapshots and graph-tidy bypass unchanged. Package backfill never injects consent. CLI/MCP errors are structured, whitelisted, redacted, and stack-free. runner-owned deliveryStatus remains untouched by Coding.

explicitEntrypoints.controlPoint: Run the deterministic journey plus actual separate CLI readiness/query processes, package backfill without a flag, System MCP and unified gateway semantic requests, no-argument snapshots, graph-tidy, invalidation, and actual wire errors.
explicitEntrypoints.observationPoint: Only explicit readiness creates durable non-secret authorization; missing/stale/init/backfill/version-changed evidence rejects before retrieval, semantic MCP calls use the operator, package consent is caller-owned, and exact safe diagnostics survive CLI/MCP wires without stacks or canaries.
explicitEntrypoints.failureReason: SP05_ADAPTER_LIFECYCLE_CONTROLS_FAILED against 587ee41: checkpoint module/process lifecycle missing, package command forges consent, System MCP performs direct retrieval, and MCP wire handlers expose stacks instead of structured diagnostics.

taskExecutionPlan.executionStrategy: Implement the minimal adapter-lifecycle boundary in three test-driven tasks. Preserve the six function ports and accepted WP-P1/WP-P2 logic; add only the store object. A prior explicit verification is mandatory. Query-time WP-P2 read is stale-evidence validation only after a checkpoint exists and cannot create authorization. All frozen tests, nine guards, contracts, README, graph authority, and runner-owned deliveryStatus records are read-only.

tasks.title: Add non-secret readiness attestation lifecycle
tasks.objective: Make explicit readiness authorization survive process reconstruction while remaining version-bound and fail-closed.
steps: Create the exact safe attestation schema and deterministic integrity digest; hash the canonical graph bytes, reject links/non-regular files/malformed or extra fields, write a restricted temporary file, fsync/close, and atomically rename.
Keep six existing function ports unchanged and require the seventh readinessAttestationStore object with record/read/clear/validate.
Clear before init and explicit/automatic backfill. After explicit verifyReadiness returns exact verified:true, record the complete safe WP-P2 diagnostics.

On query, reject missing evidence before readSemanticReadiness; if present, read WP-P2 once only to validate exact attested versions/channels. Clear and reject stale evidence with current safe diagnostics before retrieval.
tasks.completionSignal: Child-process readiness then query succeeds; missing/init/backfill/version-drift cases reject with required categories and zero unauthorized retrieval.

tasks.title: Route and serialize production adapters
tasks.objective: Make CLI, System MCP, unified MCP, and package boundaries preserve authorization, consent, and diagnostics.
steps: Create the shared whitelist serializer and MCP error result; never copy stack, raw message canaries, arbitrary properties, credentials, or unsafe source.
Refactor CLI process execution through runCliProcess with the default production factory and frozen injected composition seam; preserve request flags and output one JSON document.

Split System MCP raw semantic retrieval into a private delegate. Route public semantic getSystemArchitecture through the operator, while preserving validation, no-argument, and graph-tidy branches exactly.

Compose the store in the default journey; invalidate before external backfill and after successful canonical write. Export handleRequest(request, dependencies) from both servers and pass dependencies through unified dispatch.
Remove --explicit-opt-in from the package script; do not add another implicit consent source.
tasks.completionSignal: System and unified semantic calls record operator-query only, snapshots/graph-tidy record no operator effect, package expansion contains no consent flag, and wire errors preserve exact safe diagnostics.

openGaps: IntentDesign correction b41bdbd3c9c249f7bfcb6b45daeaa3a53511fee3 passed canonical validation and changed semprod-rel-journey-credentials plus semprod-rel-journey-readiness from backward-propagating Realizations to non-directional Associations. Independent audit defects are corrected in the frozen design: exact configuration-before-effects ordering in both successes; fixture equality except opt-in; separate recovery; complete observable error capture before canary assertions; exact default factory/tool wiring; executable authorized-source safety; and exact post-rejection snapshot/zero-effect assertions.

Second guard audit correction replaces lexical source matching with TypeScript AST inspection. Default wiring now proves exact CommonJS imports, real factory/tool calls, one exact six-function dependency object, and executable comments/unused/missing-call/extra-port rejection. Source safety now permits direct approved external plumbing while rejecting provider/model/credential defaults through assignments, aliases, object properties, logical/nullish/ternary expressions, and factory arguments.

Clean Architecture re-audit correction adds TypeChecker symbol resolution and exact callback-return mapping so imported names cannot be satisfied by locally shadowed factories or callTool. Safety uses fixed-point default-source taint so generic literals and defaults in aliases, destructuring, parameters, assignments, objects, and factory arguments cannot flow into provider/model/credential bindings.

Accepted createDefaultSemanticRetrieval(dependencies).readReadiness() remains the sole readiness authority and stays frozen. The new store records only its safe public envelope after explicit verified:true; it does not evaluate readiness or persist configuration.

Adapter audit findings are independently reproduced against 587ee41: actual System MCP semantic query returns SEMANTIC_INDEX_NOT_ALIGNED from direct retrieval instead of operator authorization; a fresh CLI query exposes SEMANTIC_READINESS_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED as a stack; unified readiness exposes a stack and loses version/channel diagnostics; npm expands semantic:backfill with hidden --explicit-opt-in.

Frozen SP-05 now also launches separate child CLI processes and exercises System/unified dispatch/wire handlers. Current RED reports missing semanticReadinessAttestationStore.js, forged package consent, direct-retrieval instead of operator-query, and unexposed structured wire handlers.

Lifecycle rationale: a durable local record is required because process memory is not an authorization boundary. It stores no secrets, is bound to graph bytes plus WP-P2 canonical/content/index/channel evidence, and is invalidated on init/backfill/canonical mutation or drift. Query without a record still performs zero reads. Query with a record may re-read WP-P2 only to invalidate stale evidence; that read cannot manufacture prior authorization.

The ninth guard executes safe and adversarial package, dispatch, wire, and checkpoint fixtures before production inspection. Existing TypeChecker provenance, readiness-reader, source-safety, and exact composition guards remain mandatory.

Inherited WP-P1/WP-P2 guard corrections remove stale assertions that permanently coupled the shared handoff slot to historical repair scopes or required future SP-05 absence. Stable invariants remain stronger: accepted persistence/retrieval/runtime files are forbidden targets and frozen; SP-01 through SP-04 entries remain mounted/frozen; delivered graph mappings remain present.

The correction baseline expects 43 total / 42 passed / 1 failed with SP-05 sole RED, semprod-operator-journey-process sole not_delivered, 36 delivered / 1 not_delivered attributes, and failure records at design/KG/test-failure-records.json. Final counts are runner-owned and must be refreshed immediately before this handoff commit.

The tracked handoff is superseded after accepted Coding commit 587ee41 only for the seven adapter-lifecycle production paths. WP-P1/WP-P2 internals, README, all frozen tests/contracts, canonical authority, and delivery status are not Coding targets.

Live Neo4j synchronization remains unavailable with neo4jUri is required for start. Deterministic acceptance uses controlled recording ports below production composition boundaries and cannot be represented as live provider/database evidence. semprod-ready-plateau remains a target-only release context and is not claimed by this handoff; if its protected production-facing gate intrinsically requires live execution, that claim remains definitively blocked until the environment is supplied.

No ImplementationToIntentTraceProposal.json is required: the corrected SP-05 testcase is mounted under the exact implementation-bearing owner, all three handoff anchors exist, and plateau/work-package exclusions are evidence-backed non-executable context.
